brief:
Prime Minister Naftali Bennett warned Benjamin Netanyahu against delaying negotiations over a potential Eisenkot government, Shehab Wire reported. Netanyahu countered with a threat to topple any alternative government, escalating tensions within Israeli political circles amid pressure to accelerate coalition formation.

The standoff reflects deepening rifts as various factions maneuver over leadership and government composition. Coalition partners face mounting pressure to resolve the impasse and finalize arrangements for a new governing structure.

title: Bennett warns Netanyahu against stalling coalition talks
